atoms.text:
Act I, Scene I:

(Captain Joth and Doctor Loyt are sitting at a conference table. Kozzer, the support alien, is chewing on a toy at their feet.)

Captain Joth: (frowning) This is the last mission I will be flying with you, Loyt. I’ve followed your mission of finding life on other planets for a long time. At some point, you just have to admit that our people, the Groggers, are the only beings that exist.

(Kozzer puts his toy at Joth’s feet, whines and looks at them hopefully.)

Doctor Loyt: (shaking his head) That’s why I am the scientist, and you are the captain! Scientists never lose hope. We’ve just been very thorough in our research, eliminating one planet after the other in our quest of finding life. This next planet on our list, Planet Blubber, looks very promising.

Captain Joth: (groaning) You say that every single time. Promising planet here, promising planet over there. And in the end (he pauses) NONE of them have had life! (in a stern voice) I am giving you one last chance, Loyt!

Doctor Loyt: That’s all I need. This will be the one!

(Kozzer makes a noise similar to barking. It seems like it approves of the final adventure.)
